name: Full Wang International Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Full Wang International Development Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the real estate market in Taiwan. The company's diverse property activities include the construction, development, and commercial trading of real estate, alongside providing leasing and agency services for property transactions. Additionally, Full Wang engages in the retail of cosmetic and skin care products. Established in 1986, its corporate headquarters are located in Taichung, Taiwan.
